title: นาฬิกา
statusNotes: Available as an editable 3D asset. The living-room game remains a 2D image scene.
dimensionsNotes: Artist-estimated, not measured. Origin at bottom centre of case. Blender X width / Y depth / Z up; front -Y.

source.provenance: Existing repository game artwork. Original crop only; model authored procedurally in Blender. No third-party model or external generation service used. Archived the original source image when upstream updated the living-room artwork; the original camera and crop retain this provenance.

camera.method: Approximate six-DOF pose fit to eight hand-picked outer-bevel corners with fixed assumed focal length and dimensions.

exports.partNodesNote: One editable node per part; frame groups contain material primitives. Hands pivot about the clock axle.

notes: Matches the visible octagonal wood case, cream dial and 2:00 hands. No numerals are visible in the source.
Wall and door trim in the crop are excluded.
Real dimensions, hidden rear geometry and focal length are assumptions.
No glass, grain texture, hanging hardware, working mechanism or live hand animation.
Preview lighting differs from the painted reference.
